captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a precision toolmaker's vise mounted on a dark, rectangular swivel base. The main vise assembly is colored in a light gray, featuring a stationary jaw at one end, a sliding jaw block on a central guide track, and a black threaded leadscrew. A black T-bar handle with spherical light gray end caps is positioned at the front to rotate the leadscrew, which linearly translates the sliding jaw along a prismatic joint to clamp workpieces.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a precision toolmaker's vise. The model should include a dark rectangular swivel base, a main light-gray vise bed with a stationary rear jaw, a sliding front jaw block, and a black threaded leadscrew controlled by a front T-bar handle with spherical end caps.
captions.factory: Construct the base using a low-profile Box primitive colored in dark gray. Build the main vise bed by combining a rectangular block with raised front and rear jaw supports, and subtract a central channel for the sliding guide. Model the movable jaw as a separate block with a bottom tongue that fits into the guide channel. Create the leadscrew using a threaded or grooved Cylinder, and attach a perpendicular cylindrical T-bar handle finished with spherical caps at both ends.
